coverage_notes.summary: Twelve targeted searches covered sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure/reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption. No new U.S. event in the bounded hourly window met the qualifying criteria.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
exclusions_observed: Kauaʻi emergency food distributions were listed as proceeding on October 1 and October 2; no cancellation or suspension was identified.
North Carolina Beacon of Hope coverage described new storm-resilience infrastructure at an operating food pantry, not a closure or service reduction.
Kansas City's Midtown Costco closure was announced before the bounded window, is a planned conversion, and was not established as the only, sole, last, or full-service grocery option for a community.
SNAP/WIC search results were older or prospective policy coverage and did not establish a newly reported immediate access interruption within the bounded window.
Other results were older, non-U.S., routine, promotional, or otherwise outside scope.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is non-authoritative; production collection remains authoritative.
